prompt: Design a premium social-media advertisement for ZipPilot, a shared neighborhood direct-mail service. Brand style: deep navy blue background (#0A1E3C), bright blue (#2F80ED) and vivid green (#5BC236) accents, clean modern sans-serif typography, high contrast, professional advertising quality. Include the provided ZipPilot logo mark (blue location pin with a house and green growth arrow) at the top with the wordmark 'ZipPilot' shown with 'Zip' in white and 'Pilot' in bright blue. All text must be spelled exactly as given, crisp and legible.  Layout: split comparison. Left side desaturated: a messy pile of crumpled coupon flyers and torn envelopes spilling into a kitchen trash bin. Right side bright and warm: a stainless fridge door with one premium navy ZipPilot mailer card held by a magnet, softly glowing. Headline top, bold white: 'Coupon packs get trashed.' Second line in vivid green: 'This card gets kept.' Sub-caption in light blue: 'One premium card. 16 trusted local businesses.' Bottom: URL 'TheZipPilot.com' in white.
